name: skillswap-cpp-terminal
description: SkillSwap — Peer-to-Peer Skill Exchange Terminal Prototype (C++17)

scripts.build: if command -v g++ >/dev/null 2>&1; then g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -g -I include src/main.cpp src/user.cpp src/student.cpp src/connection_request.cpp src/match_engine.cpp src/file_manager.cpp src/skill_swap_app.cpp -o SkillSwap; else echo 'g++ build skipped'; fi

author: SkillSwap Team
